kits.name: Studio Rock
kits.description: DRSKit: hand-made Danish maple kit, Paiste 602 cymbals. Close mics + overheads + room, 6 layers × 3 round robins on kick/snare. Rock, pop, funk.

kits.name: Metal
kits.description: CrocellKit: the kit of Danish metal band Crocell, sampled at JBOSound. Two kick drums, four toms, chinas. Tight & loud.

kits.name: Vintage Funk
kits.description: AVL Red Zeppelin: Ludwig 26" kick & 14" snare, Zildjian/Sabian cymbals. Big classic-rock / funk sound.

kits.name: Pop Pearl
kits.description: AVL Black Pearl: Pearl 22" kit, Sabian AA/AAX cymbals. Tight modern pop / rock kit.

kits.name: Jazz Bop
kits.description: AVL Blonde Bop: TAMA 18" bop kit with sticks, dark AAX ride. Jazz, swing, bossa.

kits.name: Hot Rods
kits.description: AVL Blonde Bop played with Hot Rods: soft, woody attack. Bossa, ballads, unplugged.

kits.name: Jazz Brushes
kits.description: DRSKit played with brushes ("whiskers"): taps, sweeps, brushed ride. Jazz ballads & brush swing.

kits.name: Latin Percussion
kits.description: Congas, bongos, timbales, cowbells, claves, guiro, shakers, cajon… (AVL Buskman's Holiday, VCSL, FluidR3).
